- Lead technical architecture and key engineering decisions for the Docyt web platform, owning frontend architecture, platform engineering and product development.
- Drive AI-powered development practices that improve engineering productivity, automate repetitive workflows and speed up feature delivery.
- Designed and built production MCP tooling that lets AI systems and users work with product capabilities through structured tools. It is live and actively used.
- Work with product and engineering teams to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

### Frontend Team Lead · Fullstack Engineer — SpaceO Technologies · Ahmedabad (Dec 2019 — Mar 2024)
- Built React dashboards used by 30+ enterprise clients processing thousands of financial records daily, improving data visualization performance by 40% through memoization and virtualization.
- Spearheaded a scalable full-stack platform that handled 50K+ active users with 0 downtime.
- Led a team of 4 engineers delivering enterprise-grade web applications.
- Oversaw code review processes and drove continuous improvements.

### Senior Backend Developer — Hyperlink Infosystem · Ahmedabad (Jan 2016 — Dec 2019)
- Spearheaded backend development for high-traffic applications, scaling systems to handle substantial daily request volumes.
- Administered PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, optimizing SQL queries and improving reporting speed by 25%.
- Contributed to architectural discussions and design decisions that improved system scalability.
